## Alerts & Interventions

### 🔴 High Leg Asymmetry

Leg asymmetry is 0.30 kg (BR-B05 0.2–0.4kg).

**Recommended actions:**

Add dedicated unilateral session: extra set right leg per exercise.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Testosterone

Total Testosterone is 19.2 nmol/L (BR-H01 15–19.9).

**Recommended actions:**

Review timing of blood draw; confirm pre-injection trough sample.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Free Testosterone

Free Testosterone is 0.450 nmol/L (BR-H02 0.40–0.50).

**Recommended actions:**

Check SHBG trend; consider boron optimisation.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Oestradiol

Oestradiol is 82.7 pmol/L (BR-H03 75–99).

**Recommended actions:**

Monitor libido, joint comfort, mood; may be suboptimal.

### 🟡 Fat Mass Increasing

Fat mass is 13.3 kg (BR-B02 13–14.5kg).

**Recommended actions:**

Tighten nutrition; ensure caloric surplus not excessive.

### 🟡 Suboptimal Boditrax Score

Boditrax score is 809 (BR-B08 800–819).

**Recommended actions:**

Solid; review which sub-components are dragging.

### 🟡 Low Calcium Intake

Calcium is below 800 mg on 14/14 recent logged days (average: 133).

**Recommended actions:**

- Add dairy, fortified foods, or leafy greens
- Consider supplementation if consistently low

### 🟡 Low Vitamin C Intake

Vitamin C is below 60 %DV on 10/14 recent logged days (average: 49).

- Vitamin C supports immune function and collagen synthesis

### 🟡 Low Iron Intake
